title: Recruitment of Professionals on Fixed Term Engagement on Contractual Basis for Wealth Management Services Department
summary: Bank of Baroda has announced an extension of the last date for submitting online applications and fee payments for contractual professional positions in the Wealth Management Services Department. The deadline is now extended until December 7, 2026. All other terms and conditions from the original November 4, 2026 advertisement remain unchanged.
eligibility_bullets: Positions are offered on a fixed-term engagement on a contractual basis for the Wealth Management Services (WMS) Department.
Candidates must meet the educational and professional requirements specified in the original advertisement dated 04.11.2026.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: Includes roles such as Group Head, Head Investment, Territory Head, Investment Product Manager, and Senior Relationship Manager

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official Bank of Baroda career portal.
Complete the online application and fee payment before the extended deadline of 07.12.2026.
